title: Dark knight Training Protocol
author: Austin A.
desc:
This program mixes strength, running, work capacity and a little body building elements. Emphasis on recovery and longevity, don’t ego lift. Make sure to read all exercise notes. Progress all lifts (if not specified in a different way) by adding 2.5-5lbs per week. Complete your main workout and run/WOD at different points of the day (I.e. run in the morning, lift at night or vice versa). Runs go as follows: Monday-easy run
Tuesday-Tempo run
Thursday- easy run
Friday- speed/sprints
Saturday- Long run

After your runs and on your rest day, do PT exercise for your hips, knees, back, shoulders, and anything else. If you are hurting, reduce intensity as needed. If you enjoy a certain accessory for a muscle group, switch it for the one in the program, the main point of lifting is to have fun and enjoy it. Lifts are set up to have your accessory’s on opposite days of the main lifts to help recovery and power output on those lifts. Train insane and eat to gain!
